case_metaphors.name: einstein
case_metaphors.objects: Oversized chalk hand + Einstein, clocks and orbital marks
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Scale contrast makes cognitive pressure tangible; the hand reaches into the viewer’s space.
case_metaphors.caution: Preserve live hand/figure/clock changes; never replace with a portrait slide.

case_metaphors.name: equations
case_metaphors.caution: The formula is a visual symbol, not a proof of the gravity anecdote.

case_metaphors.name: clock
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: 2 AM turns an abstract pause into a specific physical decision.
case_metaphors.caution: Time shot switch to chalk/violin wording; retain full fingers and clock.

case_metaphors.name: violin
case_metaphors.objects: Standing violinist Einstein + expanding circular stage
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Music shifts the mental frame; concentric stage is attention, not a new claim of scientific causation.
case_metaphors.caution: Keep bow/strings/shadow, not just camera zoom.

case_metaphors.name: watch
case_metaphors.objects: Hand-held pocket watch with miniature violins
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Objects compress time and practice into one image.
case_metaphors.caution: Use the short actual watch interval; avoid letting the next chaise leak into this beat.

case_metaphors.name: flow
case_metaphors.objects: Reclining violinist on a chaise, hovering cursor arrows
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Digital pointers intrude on a human practice state.
case_metaphors.caution: Type FLOW STATE then AI SHORTCUTS follows argument; not constant subtitle clutter.

case_metaphors.name: car
case_metaphors.objects: Violet striped car in changing perspective
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Fast transport introduces a familiar tool-benefit premise.
case_metaphors.caution: The car must change orientation/position in source footage, not be a still card.

case_metaphors.name: runner
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: People still train despite owning machines.
case_metaphors.caution: Protect every shoe/leg frame while cleaning old labels; motion serves contrast with car.

case_metaphors.name: engine
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Effort transferred to a machine becomes visible.
case_metaphors.caution: Do not equate body shape with worth or treat the metaphor as medical evidence.

case_metaphors.name: brain
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: The argument makes disuse visible through a fragile support structure.
case_metaphors.caution: Retain pale bandage and thin crutches; disability imagery is metaphor, not diagnosis.

case_metaphors.name: shortcut
case_metaphors.objects: Laptop suspended from bulb balloons + deflated bulb
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Ideas appear inflated while the difficult climb is absent.
case_metaphors.caution: Retain strings, screen and pale bulb highlights; the exact phrase is rhetorical.

case_metaphors.name: talent
case_metaphors.objects: Rising bulbs versus brain tied to a stone
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Opposing vertical vectors show efficiency up / talent down.
case_metaphors.caution: Mask only the active tag corner: the stone occupies the other corner.

case_metaphors.name: sandbags
case_metaphors.objects: Runner carrying a heavy bag in an empty stadium argument
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: Voluntary difficulty converts an apparently irrational action into training.
case_metaphors.caution: Protect dark-purple bag from being mistaken for heading ink; articulate weight.

case_metaphors.name: art
case_metaphors.metaphor_logic: The tool-of-art becomes the closing object and open question.
case_metaphors.caution: End in clean editorial space, not the source Instagram card.
